info.name: Round12-collabase-team-one
info.description:
CollabSpace API collection.

Set `url` to `http://127.0.0.1:8000` (server root, NO trailing /api).
All request paths include `/api/...` once.
Run Auth → login first to set `token` and `user_id`.
PUT/DELETE must use raw JSON bodies (not multipart form-data).

request.description: Update team. Use form-data name=Backend 1 (same as store) or raw JSON. display_name follows name when omitted.
Update team. Use form-data name=Backend 1 (same as store) or raw JSON. display_name follows name when omitted.
PUT update task. form-data works (same as create). Or raw JSON with Content-Type application/json. start_date example: 2026-08-01
Used by Laravel Echo to authorize private Pusher channels. Replace `socket_id` with the real value from Pusher client.
POST {{url}}/profile/files — set collection var url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/api (do NOT add another /api in the path). Max 10MB.
Counts: to_do, in_progress, in_review, completed, done, total.
status: pending | in_progress | in_review | completed
Recent tasks, messages, and projects for the authenticated user.
Full profile: name, email, phone, about, job title, experience, availability, current team/project, teams, files.
Update profile. Prefer JSON body. Query also works: PUT {{url}}/api/profile?name=Miro
Filters: status, file_type, extension, project_id, task_id, mine=1
Upload without attaching. Use Attach endpoint later.
Removes file from project/task but keeps it in storage (detached).
Permanently deletes file from DB and storage.
All conversations where the authenticated user is a participant.
Create/get direct chat. Optional body/message sets last_message on the response.
GET find-or-create project chat from project teams + creator.
POST project group chat. user_ids is required (group member IDs). Creator is always included.
Sends a message and broadcasts `message.sent` on private channel `conversation.{id}` via Pusher.
Generated from cURL: curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/api/dashboard/stats" -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}"
Generated from cURL: curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/api/dashboard/recent-files" -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}"
Generated from cURL: curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/api/dashboard/project-overview?project_id=1" -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer {{token}}"
List meetings for the authenticated user (creator or participant).
Calendar grouped by date with meetings for each day.
Upcoming meetings within the next N days (default 7, max 365).
